projects.name: DUAL EXAM: CONTROLLED EVALUATION OF MULTIMODAL AGENTS AND WORLD MODELS
projects.description: Dual Exam uses two controlled evaluation tracks to assess multimodal agents’ decision-making and task completion, and world models’ action effects and state consistency. Spanning physical, digital, social, and scientific domains, it analyzes execution evidence to distinguish failures in agents, world models, and their interaction.
projects.image_alt: DUAL EXAM evaluation framework for multimodal agents and world models across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains

projects.name: Pipelined CPU Design Based on the LoongArch ISA
projects.description: Designed and verified a five-stage LoongArch CPU, using data forwarding and pipeline stalls to handle hazards. Implemented an AXI interface, CSRs and interrupt/exception handling, a TLB, and two-way set-associative instruction and data caches. Predecode-based timing optimization enabled a 60 MHz clock, with over 10,000 lines of Verilog.
